unit: household including all persons and diary days
stratification: home_county, exact publisher label; null or empty becomes __missing__
rank: ascending SHA256 of UTF-8 seed + newline + canonical decimal hh_id; break hash ties by integer hh_id
other_counties: assign partitions but exclude from this seven-county study before outcomes
household_weight_filter: none during splitting; preserve unweighted respondents in the roster
outcome_access: none before full preregistration, synthetic preparation proof and model-input admission; query development household IDs server-side only
held_out_outcomes: never request, download, parse or summarize in this task
inference: development-only regional evidence; household holdout is not independent geographic transfer
panel_policy: one wave only; never join other waves; retain all repeat days with their household
revision_policy: immutable after this commit; preserve excluded and missing-geography counts
